resources.string: Set and save visible left/right boundaries, or record visibility observations.
Start the square while parked, then use Adjust square to move it. L/R mark image edges, not vehicle sides. The square stops when you leave or after 3 minutes without input.
Square stopped. Start again to check or adjust boundaries.
What do you see on the windscreen?

The latest 128 observations survive closing the app and are included in Diagnostics. Observation buttons only log what you see; Save calibration applies the horizontal limits. Android cannot detect optical clipping or factory graphics.
Square stopped after 3 minutes without input. Saved observations are retained.
